summary.name: Daz 3D
summary.one_liner: Daz 3D's AI page markets its structured, licensed 3D asset library (characters, morphs, clothing, props, environments) as training data for machine learning teams.
use_cases: simulate environments for robotics or autonomous systems
build synthetic human datasets for healthcare or pose analysis
support virtual try-on and retail visualization
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a library of millions of 3D assets built over two decades, including fully rigged characters, morph systems, clothing, accessories, materials, props and environments. Daz positions this as structured, machine-readable data that can produce automatically labeled ground truth such as segmentation and depth. It targets teams in gaming, computer vision, robotics, autonomous systems, defense, AR/VR, retail and healthcare. The page asks visitors to request access and does not describe a self-serve tool, interface or pricing.
notable: Claims fully licensed, commercially safe 3D datasets for AI training
Automatic generation of ground truth labels, segmentation and depth data
Library of fully rigged characters with morph systems
Access by request only per the page
caveats: Access is by request; no pricing or self-serve signup is stated
Page is mostly marketing, with few technical specifics about formats or licensing terms
Listing tags the tool as paid, but the page itself does not state prices
